g.text: UK: published national totals, annual windows ending June; no detailed age-by-sex split. SOC2010 pre-2022 values are not linked across the break.
Sweden: annual native SSYK251 is broader than exact software developers (SSYK2512). Actual ages are shown; 2023 provider-imputed occupations are flagged.
These are separate sources and populations, not estimates of a common AI effect.
